phrases.latin: Nucem Indicam cultrō magnō aperiam; tū procul stā.
phrases.english: I’ll open the coconut with the big knife; you stand well back.

phrases.latin: Haec nux tam dūra est ut frangī nōn possit.
phrases.english: This nut is so hard it won’t crack.

phrases.latin: quī ē nuce nuculeum ēsse volt, frangit nucem
phrases.english: whoever wants to eat the kernel from the nut must crack the nut

sources: Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: numbered food and kitchen sections
